About the Team 
 The New Vertical Onboarding Strategy & Operations team drives a fast, seamless onboarding experience for merchants across the SMB segments. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to enhance visibility, streamline workflows, and reduce onboarding friction through scalable process and product improvements. Our mission is to ensure every merchant launches smoothly and efficiently, powered by data-driven insights and strong operational alignment.
 About the Role 
 The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. offres.extrait:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds with our most strategic customers to build production AI systems on Claude. The team takes on work where no playbook exists yet, turns what works into repeatable patterns for partners and our field teams, and brings what it learns back to Product and Research. Demand for FDE is well ahead of the team's capacity, and the team is growing quickly across the Americas, Europe and Asia.
 We're hiring a dedicated Strategy & Operations Lead for FDE. You'll be the strategy partner to FDE leadership and own the plan: headcount and capacity, the mix of work the team takes on, how engagements are priced and measured, and how more of the work moves to partners. You'll run the business reviews and build the reporting leadership uses to make these calls.

Rejoindre la Métropole du Grand Nancy et la Ville de Nancy, c’est l’opportunité de travailler au cœur d’un territoire d’exception alliant innovation, patrimoine et qualité de vie. En collaborant sur des projets mutualisés, vous contribuerez à façonner l’avenir de deux collectivités emblématiques : la Métropole, avec ses 20 communes, et la Ville de Nancy, capitale de l’Art nouveau et classée au patrimoine mondial de l’Unesco. Vous participerez à des missions stimulantes et variées dans un cadre de travail dynamique et inspirant.La direction des finances est une direction mutualisée, intégrée au pôle ressources de la Métropole du Grand Nancy et de la Ville de Nancy.  As Sr Planning Analyst Partner Revenue, you will co-own with the Planning Lead the revenue planning of Glovo's monetisation streams, with end-to-end ownership of Promotions: the promotional budget Glovo invests in partners and the Prime order vendor fee. You will build the models and forecasts that set the targets, then make sure every market is aligned with them and delivers. Over the next 12–18 months you will turn promotions into an optimised, measurable investment, keep the business plan in Anaplan (Glovo planning software) as the single source of truth, and guarantee that every Ads product is billed correctly to partners.
